body:
UP-Term 1.6 makes `upkg browse` fast on a 68k, lets the AmigaDOS Shell find `upkg`, and gives CON: windows the UP-Term look.

Only the base (up-term.lha) changes in this release. The add-ons keep their 1.3 versions.

## Changes

- `upkg browse` comes back to the list at once after Enter (info) or a refused key. It reads the package lists again only after an install, upgrade or remove. Before, every return to the list read all three lists, which took about 40 seconds on an A1200.
- `upkg list-upgradable` (and so the browse list) no longer checks every installed file on disk. It only compares versions.
- `upkg` works in the AmigaDOS Shell, not only in an UP-Term window: Install adds an `Alias upkg` block to S:Shell-Startup. Uninstall removes it again. A new Shell picks it up.
- CON: and RAW: windows opened through UP-Term get the UP-Term background and colours. Amiga programs keep their own escape codes, so they draw as before.
- The UP-Term icon opens its window as wide as the screen.

Known: in a CON: window, text a program prints in pen 1 (black) does not show on the new black background.

## Install

You need a 68020 or better and AmigaOS 3.0 or newer. upkg downloads over the network: it needs a TCP/IP stack (Roadshow, Miami or AmiTCP) and AmiSSL 5, and the curl option ticked in Install.

New install:

1. Download `up-term.lha` from the assets below and unpack it with lha.
2. Double-click `Install` in the UP-Term drawer. Tick the optional parts you want, curl among them. Without Installer, use the Shell route in the kit's README.txt.
3. Reboot after Install. XCON: and PTY: are mounted from then on.
4. Open an UP-Term window and run `upkg update`, then `upkg browse`.

Upgrade from 1.3, 1.4 or 1.5: unpack the 1.6 `up-term.lha` and run its `Install`. The first page names the installed version and offers Update (the default). Update copies only the files that changed and keeps your choices and your add-ons. `upkg` is part of the base, so a new version of it always comes with up-term.lha, never as an ipk.

## Add-ons (upkg feed)

These ipk packages are in this release's feed (`Packages`, `Packages.gz`). They keep their 1.3 versions.

| Add-on | Version | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| up-claude | 1.1 | Claude Code for the Amiga (C:Claude) |
| up-pi | 1.0 | amiga-pi, the pi coding agent |
| up-nvim | 1.0 | Neovim 0.12 in UP-Term:nvim |
| up-python | 1.0 | Python 3.14 in SYS:Python3 |
| up-git | 1.0 | git 2.56.0 |
| up-perl | 1.0 | Perl 5.42.3 |
| up-vim | 1.0 | Vim 9.2.1202 |

Without the list:

```
upkg update                 fetch the feed's package list
upkg list                   the packages the feed offers
upkg list-installed         the add-ons you have
upkg list-upgradable        the add-ons with a newer version in the feed
upkg info <name>            details of one add-on
upkg install <name>         install an add-on
upkg upgrade                bring the installed add-ons up to the feed
upkg remove <name>          remove an add-on
upkg --help                 all commands
```

The .lha archives of up-claude, up-pi, up-nvim and up-python are also here. Use them to install those add-ons without upkg.

## Assets

- `up-term.lha`: the base kit, version 1.6.
- `*.ipk`, `Packages`, `Packages.gz`: the add-on feed that upkg reads.
- `upkg-index.txt`: the index of the .lha archives.
- `up-claude.lha`, `up-pi.lha`, `up-nvim.lha`, `up-python.lha`: stand-alone archives.
- `up-term-src.lha`: the source of the base.

Built from spotUP/UP-Term acca84c6, upterm ba6217f. The kit's VERSIONS file lists the commit of each repository.
